parameters.command:
=cd /home/kali/Desktop/AutoPentestX && \
source .venv/bin/activate && \
echo "yes" | python3 main.py -t {{$node["Webhook"].json["body"]["target"]}} -n "NetraThip-{{$node["Webhook"].json["body"]["scanJobId"]}}" && \
cat $(ls -td reports/*.json | head -n 1)

=cd /home/kali/Desktop/guardian-cli/guardian-cli-main && \
source venv/bin/activate && \


export T_PROV="{{$node["Webhook2"].json["body"]["parameters"]["ai_provider"]}}" && \
export T_MODEL="{{$node["Webhook2"].json["body"]["secrets"]["model"]}}" && \
export T_KEY="{{$node["Webhook2"].json["body"]["secrets"]["ai_api_key"]}}" && \
export T_URL="{{$node["Webhook2"].json["body"]["secrets"]["base_url"]}}" && \


export OPENAI_API_KEY="$T_KEY" && \
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="$T_KEY" && \
export GEMINI_API_KEY="$T_KEY" && \
if [ -n "$T_URL" ]; then export OPENAI_BASE_URL="$T_URL"; fi && \


sed -i -E "s|^[[:space:]]*provider:.*|  provider: ${T_PROV}|g" config/guardian.yaml && \
sed -i -E "s|^[[:space:]]*model:.*|    model: \"${T_MODEL}\"|g" config/guardian.yaml && \
sed -i -E "s|^[[:space:]]*api_key:.*|    api_key: ${T_KEY}|g" config/guardian.yaml && \
if [ -n "$T_URL" ]; then \
  sed -i -E "s|^[[:space:]]*base_url:.*|    base_url: \"${T_URL}\"|g" config/guardian.yaml; \
fi && \


python -m cli.main workflow run \
  --name {{$node["Webhook2"].json["body"]["parameters"]["workflow_name"]}} \
  --target {{$node["Webhook2"].json["body"]["target"]}} > /dev/null 2>&1 &&\

cat $(ls -td reports/session_*.json | head -n 1)
